findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "faith-mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: compose_prayer_request, get_my_giving_record, search_sermons, get_sermon, sermon_study_guide, pay_with_x402, get_audio_devotional, synthesize_speech · Private data: find_churches, submit_prayer_request, get_my_giving_record, sermon_prep_kit, pay_with_x402, get_api_key_status, get_audio_devotional, synthesize_speech, get_faith_context · Public sink: submit_prayer_request, compose_prayer_request, get_my_giving_record, search_sermons, get_sermon, sermon_study_guide, sermon_prep_kit, pay_with_x402 · Destructive: pay_with_x402.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: compose_prayer_request, get_my_giving_record, search_sermons, get_sermon, sermon_study_guide, pay_with_x402, get_audio_devotional, synthesize_speech · Private data: find_churches, submit_prayer_request, get_my_giving_record, sermon_prep_kit, pay_with_x402, get_api_key_status, get_audio_devotional, synthesize_speech, get_faith_context · Public sink: submit_prayer_request, compose_prayer_request, get_my_giving_record, search_sermons, get_sermon, sermon_study_guide, sermon_prep_kit, pay_with_x402 · Destructive: pay_with_x402

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
